_comment: Expected non-secret configuration per backend environment, compared weekly
(scripts/check_environments.py). Booleans mean 'the env var is set' — never
values. Volatile fields (commit_sha, worker_pid, machine_id, region) are
reported but not compared. Update this file in the same PR as a deliberate
secret/config change. Human-readable table: frontend repo docs/environments.md.

deliberately_different.captcha_configured: Unset on staging: verify_recaptcha() returns True when the secret is missing, so test.ohack.dev forms skip reCAPTCHA. Open decision (plan decision 2).
deliberately_different.resend_configured: Unset on staging: no participant emails from test. Open decision (plan decision 2).
deliberately_different.stripe_configured: Unset on staging: admin deposit refunds can't run on test. Open decision (plan decision 2).
deliberately_different.cron_token_configured: Unset on staging. The hourly deadline-reminder workflow targets api.ohack.dev (vars.BACKEND_URL), so staging only needs it if that cron is pointed at test.api. Open decision (plan decision 3).

known_gaps.cache_backend: No REDIS_URL in either app (Nov 2026): every cache is per process, up to 4 copies in prod (2 machines x 2 workers). Decided: no Redis for now — read_after_write caches are <=10s instead (common/utils/cache_registry.py).
known_gaps.hacker_deposit_webhook_configured: STRIPE_HACKER_DEPOSIT_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set in NEITHER app: POST /api/webhooks/stripe/hacker-deposit can't verify signatures. Harmless while deposits are disabled; set it (and flip this to true) before enabling deposits.
